simple.meaning: מָגוֹר (mâgôwr) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with flocks and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Lamentations, beginning at Psalms 31:14. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, flock, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָגוֹר (H4032) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מָגוֹר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מָגוֹר (mâgôwr) / H4032 is tracked through Psalms 31:14, Isaiah 31:9, Jeremiah 6:25, Jeremiah 20:4. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

evidence: Occurrence trail contains male relationship language

firstOccurrence.englishText: But I trust in you, Yahweh.

timeline.evidenceText: But I trust in you, Yahweh.
His rock will pass away by reason of terror,
Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.

For Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.
For I have heard the defaming of many,
They will take their tents and their flocks.
“You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side.

definitions.full: H4032. magor or magur מָגוֺר noun masculine fear, terror — absolute ׳מ Psa 31:14 6 t. + Jer 20:3 compare below; plural suffix מְגוּרַי Lam 2:22 ; — fear, terror Isa 31:9 ; = cause of terror Jer 20:4 ; elsewhere in phrase, coined by Jeremiah, ׳מ מִסָּבִיב terror on every side 6:25 ; 20:3 (where as proper name), 20:10 ; 46:5 ; 49:29 ; Psa 31:14 ; Lam 2:22 ( מִסּ ׳מְגוּרַי ).
